text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Melbourne are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

sections.text:
Based on my knowledge and the search results, here is a comprehensive overview of Melbourne's prestige real estate agencies that are market leaders in luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing:

---

## 🏙️ Melbourne's Leading Prestige Real Estate Agencies for Luxury Developments

---

### 1. 🏆 Marshall White Projects
Marshall White are the leading prestige real estate agents for luxury properties in Melbourne.

annotations.title: Best Luxury Real Estate Agents in Melbourne

sections.text:
Their dedicated **Marshall White Projects** division is one of the most recognised names in off-the-plan and new development marketing. They handle some of Melbourne's most architecturally significant boutique apartment projects, particularly in blue-chip suburbs like Toorak, South Yarra, Brighton, and Kew. They are known for their deep buyer database and ability to achieve strong off-the-plan sales results for developer clients.

---

### 2. 🏅 Kay & Burton
Kay & Burton is widely regarded as one of Melbourne's most exclusive prestige agencies, with a strong footprint in the inner east — Toorak, South Yarra, Hawthorn, and Portsea. They regularly market architecturally designed new residences and boutique developments, and their brand is synonymous with ultra-high-end buyers. Their project arm markets luxury off-the-plan apartments and penthouse residences to a highly curated buyer pool.

---

### 3. 🏅 RT Edgar
RT Edgar has a long-standing reputation in Melbourne's prestige market, particularly across the inner-eastern and Mornington Peninsula corridors. Their projects division markets luxury new developments and off-the-plan penthouses, often working with boutique developers on architecturally significant builds.

---

### 4. 🏅 Jellis Craig Projects
Jellis Craig's dedicated projects arm operates across Melbourne's inner and middle-ring suburbs. They have established themselves as a go-to agency for developer-led architectural projects and boutique off-the-plan campaigns in suburbs like Fitzroy, Carlton, Hawthorn, and Kew.

---

### 5. 🏅 Zammit Real Estate
Zammit Real Estate is a leader in luxury penthouses, offering exclusive penthouses for sale in Melbourne and surrounding suburbs.

annotations.title: 18 Exclusive Penthouses for Sale in Melbourne, VIC, 3000

sections.text:
They specialise in high-end CBD and inner-city off-the-plan apartments and penthouses, including flagship projects on St Kilda Road and Collins Street. Their portfolio includes some of Melbourne's most iconic and high-value penthouse residences.

---

### 6. 🏅 Clements International

Clements International's core philosophy is to achieve extraordinary real estate results for every client by tailoring their approach to the unique strengths of each property. As a trusted boutique agency, they prioritise precision, strategy, and exclusivity over volume.

They are active in marketing luxury off-the-plan developments and penthouse residences across Melbourne's prestige precincts.

---

### 7. 🏅 Abercromby's Real Estate
Abercromby's is a boutique prestige agency with a strong presence in Armadale, Toorak, and South Yarra. They are known for handling high-end off-the-plan projects and architecturally designed residences, often working with award-winning developers and architects on exclusive campaigns.

---

### 8. 🏅 Melcorp Luxe / Melcorp Real Estate
Melcorp Luxe offers exclusive residences for lease and to own, with a collection of luxury apartments handpicked for those who value location, lifestyle, and discretion.

annotations.title: Luxury Real Estate, Residences & Apartments in Melbourne

sections.text: They specialise in Melbourne's most exclusive homes and penthouses, where architectural excellence, location, and prestige come together.

annotations.title: Luxury Real Estate, Residences & Apartments in Melbourne

sections.text:
They are particularly active in the Southbank, CBD, and Docklands luxury apartment market.

---

### 9. 🏅 CBRE Residential Projects (Melbourne)
CBRE's residential projects division is one of the largest and most active project marketing agencies in Melbourne, handling major luxury off-the-plan towers and mixed-use precincts. They work with institutional developers and are known for large-scale prestige project launches.

---

### 10. 🏅 Colliers Residential / JLL Residential
Both Colliers and JLL have dedicated residential project marketing arms in Melbourne that handle landmark luxury developments, often involving international developers, branded residences, and architecturally significant towers.

---
